wSTRC.description: Non-rebasing wrapper for STRC. Exchange rate grows as STRC dividends rebase.

PythOracleAdapter.description: Active oracle. Morpho oracle adapter. Reads STRC/USD from Pyth and adjusts for wSTRC/STRC exchange rate. maxStaleness = 7 days (works through weekends and afterhours).

PythOracleAdapterOld.description: DEPRECATED. maxStaleness = 24h, causes staleness errors on weekends/afterhours.

Batcher.description: Atomic wrap + supplyCollateral + borrow in one transaction. NOTE: deployed with 80% LLTV — needs redeployment with 86% to match active market.

oldMarket.description: DEPRECATED — uses 24h oracle, migrate positions to activeMarket
